evidence.claim: Customer reported unrecognized online charge; purchase deviates from typical spending categories

case.summary: Confirmed unauthorized activity (card not present fraud) on card C11923-K2. Cardholder denied purchase. Total exposure: $100.00. Card blocked for customer protection.

evidence_requests.assumed_response: Customer states they did not make this purchase, did not share credentials, and still has the physical card.

initial.reason: Customer initiated dispute regarding unauthorized charge
R1: Confirm details of unauthorized activity with cardholder

final.reason: R2: Customer denied activity; exposure $100.00 (L1 approval)
R2: Internal fraud case opened with evidence graph attached

next_best_actions.what_changed: Customer denial confirmed compromise, elevating probability to 0.94 and triggering BLOCK_CARD and internal case creation.

sar.reason: Policy threshold not met: confirmed loss under $1,000 and isolated to single account

stop_reason: Defensible decision reached with corroborating evidence and verification; card protected and SAR generated.
